objective.title: Preserve the real heat-kernel initial-data limit on Lean 4.33
objective.statement: Repair only the tendsto_heatSolution_nhdsGT_zero proof body. Preserve all three exact public types, private proofs and headers, canonical volume, Gaussian normalization and real-complex conversion, original integrability/pointwise continuity/right-sided-time hypotheses, and every other byte. This supports retained full-root verification of the final adapter using proved S plus separately verified upstream smooth Poincare. Existing Euclidean initial-data-limit consumers use it; it does not construct an independent manifold heat kernel, universal Hamilton flow or limit.
deliverables: The original real approximate identity compiles at all frozen types with axiom/safety and whole surrounding-source guards.
